items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 106:1
items.html: Ruach means the light of spirit, which is VAK, and the Hesed of Atik clothed in the Galgalta of Arich Anpin is called 'the spirit concealed in Atik Yomin.' For it is the aspect of the body of Atik and its VAK. And it is called Avir dakia, because the Yud does not go out of its air, since the Galgalta was corrected in the aspect of the MEM of Tzelem, as is known. (Page 322, Item 63).
